messages:
maria: Heads up — huge spike into eu-west2 at ~13:02, autoscaler didn't add GPUs, lots of pods Pending. Anyone on infra?

alex: seeing it. Scale signal increased ~10x but provisioner stuck in creating state for 7m. k8s events show FailedScheduling + insufficient GPU.

infra-bot: EVENTS: Pod gpu-batch-9abc Pending — FailedScheduling: 0/24 nodes are available: 18 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 6 node(s) didn't match nodeSelector.

sourabh: checked cloud logs — provider returned quotaExceeded for gpu-a100-eu-west2-b. Provisioner was pinned to zone b via topologyHint and never attempted other zones.

jess: shifted noncritical traffic to eu-west1-canary to buy time. Expect colder caches and +200ms p95.

toby: attempted to toggle zoneFallback but config is gated. I applied a temp patch to allow cross-zone fallback on the provisioner config map; new node requests sent to eu-west2-c and eu-west2-d.

alex: paste of kube-provisioner tail: ```
2026-03-18T13:02:15Z ERROR create_node: provider error: quotaExceeded: GPUs quota reached in project
2026-03-18T13:03:01Z WARN retrying create_node (retry 12)
```

maria: can we make quotaExceeded a terminal error so the provisioner falls back immediately? Right now it's retrying and holding up the queue.

sourabh: yes — root cause: (1) zonal GPU quota exhausted in zone b, (2) provisioner treated quota errors as transient, (3) autoscaler signaled scale-up but node creation loop kept retrying same zone -> scale gap.

oncall: manual failover executed — routing rules updated to move critical traffic to eu-west1 and us-west2. Critical queues back to green.

alex: note on cost: cross-region failover will incur inter-region egress and replica costs. We'll need to flag billing for this incident.

jess: for immediate mitigation I suggest: (a) mark gpu-a100 in eu-west2-b as hot quota request to cloud ops, (b) enable cross-zone fallback by default for burst traffic, (c) add alert for repeated create_node quota errors.

toby: filed an infra PR to treat quotaExceeded as terminal and trigger fallback within 5s. Also adding an observability metric: provider.quota_rejections/sec.

maria: good. action items: sourabh + toby to own hotfix and postmortem, alex to open billing impact ticket, jess to update runbook for zone-fallback steps. I'll follow up with an incident doc. :thumbsup:

maria: quick outputs I grabbed:```
kubectl get pods -A | grep Pending
namespace   pod                         STATUS    NODE
ml          gpu-batch-9abc              Pending   <none>
ml          gpu-batch-9def              Pending   <none>
```

maria: kube-provisioner excerpts:```
E 13:02:14 create_node failed: quotaExceeded (gpu-a100-eu-west2-b)
W 13:02:40 retrying create_node (attempt 9)
W 13:03:05 still retrying, not failing over
```

maria: last note — need short-term guardrail: if X quota_rejections in Y seconds then fallback to other zones; long-term: decouple topologyHint default when GPUs requested.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0346 (severity: medium) — assigned to eng-infra and eng-sre.

maria: thanks all — we'll document next steps in the incident board and follow up with a postmortem.
